sourceText:
Schedule 1 No Shooting, Hunting or Trapping Areas (Section 2)
Serpentine River
10 That portion of the Province, in the vicinity of Mud Bay, NWD, that is within the following boundaries: The portion of MU 2-4 between the Serpentine River and Nicomekl River and including Lots 450, Group 2 and 160, Group 2; fraction Northeast quarter of Section 33, Township 1; Southeast quarter Section 4, Township 2, NWD; the most northerly boundary of the area being the north bank of the Serpentine River between Highway 499 and Highway 99.
